name: std::ranges::adjacent_transform_view<V,F,N>::size

declarations.code:
constexpr auto size() const
    requires ranges::sized_range<const InnerView>;

intro:
Returns the number of elements.

Let inner_ be the underlying object of type InnerView (that is the ranges::adjacent_view<V,N>).

1,2) Equivalent to return inner_.size();.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of elements, may be 0 if the size of the underlying view V is less than N.
